letters.title: Letter 1
letters.text: On your special birthday, may joy and success follow you wherever you go! Have a wonderful day!

letters.title: Letter 2
letters.text: Happy Birthday! Wishing you countless blessings, perfect health, and endless smiling moments!

letters.title: Letter 3
letters.text: Another adventure-filled year awaits you! May all your heartfelt wishes come true this year!
